question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. came.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"approached"** means to come near or nearer to (someone or something) in distance or time. (निकट आना)

 
 
• **Example: **As we approached the city, the buildings became taller and more impressive.
 
 
 
• **"Came"** is the past tense of "come." It means to move or travel towards or into a place thought of as near or familiar to the speaker. (आया)
 
 
• **Example: **She came to the party despite the bad weather.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "came."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **came**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Established** (स्थापित): To set up on a firm or permanent basis.

 
 
• **Example:** The company was established in 1990 and has grown significantly since then.
 
 
 
• **Approached** (निकट आना): To come near or nearer to someone or something in distance or time.
 
 
• **Example:** As we approached the city, the buildings became taller and more impressive.
 
 
 
• **Comes** (आता है): Third person singular present tense of "come."
 
 
• **Example:** She comes to the office every day at 9 AM.
```
